segments.text: Dad, what is it?
It is ENIAC, the best-known early computer.
A computer?! But it has no mouse or keyboard?
The first computer did not have a mouse or keyboard. It was as big as a room. Besides, it was 30 tons. It was as heavy as four elephants. People used it to do difficult maths tasks.
Cool! But today computers are much smaller. What makes this happen?
The microchip. Microchips are very important to computers. With microchips, scientists can make very small computers.
How small can a computer be now?
In 2018, scientists made super small computers. They were as small as a grain of salt.
How amazing! I love computers. We can do a lot of things with a computer now. My classmates and I can send emails, search for information and do our homework better.
Dear Simon,
I’ve got a new computer as a gift from my grandpa. My little brother often turns on my computer and messes up my files. It’s really bad. What should I do?
From Star 88
Hi Star 88!
You need to set a power-on password. You can set a password by using eight different letters, numbers and symbols. Keep it to yourself and don’t tell others. Good luck.
Simon
Dear Simon,
I carelessly dropped some milk on the desktop keyboard. Now my keyboard does not work. I am worried. Is my computer broken? I don’t know what to do. Please help me!
From Lightning 99
Hi Lightning 99!

A little milk on the keyboard does not matter too much. Clean the keyboard first. And leave it to dry. If you are worried, you can ask parents to help you check the computer. Remember, do not drink milk or other drinks while using the computer in the future.
Simon
